parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description:
Personal access token.  
This field is not required when using Alibaba Cloud AccessKey ID and AccessKey Secret (AK+SK) or Security Token Service (STS) temporary authorization.

parameters.name: createParentPath
parameters.description:
Whether to create the parent folder.  
Valid values: true / false

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: Organization identifier, also known as organization ID, in string format. It can be obtained from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps URL, for example: https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】

parameters.name: sync
parameters.description:
Whether to execute repository Creation synchronously  
Valid values: true / false
